high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "allthingsmoviesandtv." The post was shared 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken, as indicated by the timestamp at the top right corner of the image. The main content of the post features two individuals: Mark Wahlberg on the left and Paul Walter Hauser on the right. Both are professionally dressed, with Wahlberg wearing a casual gray cap and a dark shirt, while Hauser is in a suit with a white shirt and tie.
